scientific_integrity.basis: analytic proof plus independently evaluated numerical checks

scientific_limitations: Exact three-consecutive-interior-site principal Toeplitz restriction only; not a general multi-site theorem.
Fourier-symbol fractional Laplacian, not the fractional power of a finite nearest-neighbour Dirichlet Laplacian.
Continuous-time exact matrix exponential; not time-stepping or numerical roundoff.
Prior sign-loss and general eventual-positivity theory are expressly credited. Publication priority in specialized matrix-exponential literature is not conclusively settled.
Finite computational checks corroborate analytic proof but cannot certify an infinite theorem.
title: Sharp three-site positivity recovery for exact-symbol fractional diffusion
